scope: Source and coefficient audit for the preliminary HCN update; no production thermochemistry change, independent FastChem solve, spectrum or retrieval.

provider_statement.author: Daniel Kitzmann
provider_statement.inspection: Provider comment and supplied table headers inspected.
provider_statement.summary: The provider reports similar heat capacities across compilations and an HCN refit using Goos/Burcat. The tables retain the previous ion update and await approval for an official repository change.
provider_statement.historical_measurement_claim: The provider attributes JANAF's HCN formation enthalpy to an 1886 measurement. The original measurement and that attribution were not independently inspected here.
provider_statement.limit: The exact input database bytes, fitting temperature grid, weights and atomic-reference construction were not supplied. A source-family citation does not identify a reproducible fit recipe.

file_audits.alias_evidence: Both headers explicitly identify Hydrogen_Cyanide_HCN with C:H:N = 1:1:1. Old/new coefficients match the respective standard-file HCN records. HNC remains the distinct, unchanged C1H1N1_2 record.

supplied_archives.interpretation: Only the HCN coefficient record changes after the explicit Hoeijmakers alias is applied. Raw identifier catalogs do change in that file; formula matching alone would incorrectly conflate HCN and HNC.

public_burcat_source.version_scope: The mirror index identifies a 23 July 2023 copy; the file header says species were last added on 3 January 2023. The DOI identifies the 2005 report, not these 2023 bytes.
public_burcat_source.inspection: Public file header, ATcT code definitions and HCN/HNC entries inspected with the web reader. No original-response byte hash or claim of identity with the provider's private input copy.
public_burcat_source.location: BURCAT.THR header and ATcT A code definition; HCN CAS 74-90-8 entry, web-reader lines 2988-2999, followed by the separate HNC entry.
public_burcat_source.selected_hcn_reference: ATcT A; NASA7 record header is HCN ATcT/A.
public_burcat_source.atct_a_definition: Unpublished ATcT v1.25 results based on Core (Argonne) Thermochemical Network v1.049, May 2005.
public_burcat_source.parenthetical_hcn_reference: ATcT C 2011; listed for comparison, not the selected polynomial's energy.
public_burcat_source.interpretation: A database-wide 2023 date does not mean every species energy was updated in 2023. This entry shares ATcT ancestry with curated, so their agreement is not independent validation.

current_curated_reference.selection: CEA thermal functions plus ATcT 1.172 balanced atomization energy.
current_curated_reference.hypothesis_scope: The displayed energy difference is a plausible contributor to the remaining offset. The energy-only ratio assumes identical thermal functions and atomic references; it is not an attribution of the whole supplied fit or proof of which Burcat copy was used.

coefficient_diagnostics.convention: L = ln(Kp) = a1/T + a2 ln(T) + a3 + a4 T + a5 T^2; molecular formation from neutral atoms; dimensionless Kp at 1 bar.
coefficient_diagnostics.delta_definition: HCN update minus previous preliminary table.

delta_lnK_fit.form: A/T + B, ordinary least squares on 251 uniformly spaced temperature nodes

derived_reaction_heat_capacity.formula: Delta Cp = R [Delta a2 + 2 Delta a4 T + 6 Delta a5 T^2]

coefficient_diagnostics.interpretation: The supplied change is predominantly an energy offset, with a small change of the fit-derived reaction Cp. These are derivatives of fitted formation constants, not independent calorimetry. The coefficient a1 alone is not an atomization energy because all five coefficients change.

remaining_limits: The broad HCN source discrepancy is substantially reduced, not eliminated. Catalog integrity and numerical agreement do not establish physical accuracy.
The supplied preliminary coefficient set is identified exactly; the external fitting inputs and procedure remain a separate unresolved provenance task.
No numerical abundance response, spectrum, metallicity bias or correlated physical uncertainty is established by this source-only audit.
